full_judgment:
2. Short facts are that the respondent filed Writ Petition No. 1969 of 1995 before the High Court Division challenging the order of refusing delivery of possession of the de-requisitioned 0.66 acre of land appertaining to CS Plot Nos. 407, 432, 433 and 434 of Khatian No. 401 out of requisitioned 2.71 acres land of the aforesaid plots of Mouza Senpara Parbata under Police Station-Mirpur, District-Dhaka in LA Case No. 50/64-65 alleging, inter alia, that the said 0.66 acre land was purchased by her from Muhammad Santoo and 4 others by registered sale deed No. 24383 dated 20-12-1980 and she go her name mutated in the records of the Revenue Department and, paid rent. After purchase she substituted herself as an awardee in place of the original awardee from whom she purchased the said 0.66 acre land and thereafter prayed for de-requisition of the said 0.66 acre of purchased land. A Title Suit for declaration of title filed against her by some third party was pending and ultimately dismissed on contest and thereafter the said third party unsuccessfully filed Title Appeal. After the disposal of litigation 0.66 acre of land purchased by her from the aforesaid three plots was de-requisitioned on 8-6-1994 after taking an undertaking from her on 9-6-1994 stating therein that she would not have any other claim over the de-requisitioned land. Thereafter on her prayer, the authority decided to hand over the vacant possession of the de-requisitioned land and the surveyor was directed to hand over possession of the said de-requisitioned 0.66 acre land to her. The surveyor went to the locality on 3-7-1994 but he could not measure and ascertain the land due to raising objection and physical assault made by the persons in possession. The Land Acquisition Officer then started a Miscellaneous Case being No. 02 of 2003 and illegally held up the possession for 13 months and ultimately, on 11-7-1995, passed the impugned order refusing to give delivery of possession of the said 0.66 acre de-requisitioned land to her. 

 8. It is not disputed that an area of 0.66 acre of land appertaining to CS Plot Nos. 407, 432, 433 and 434 of Khatian No. 401 including other lands of Mouza Senpara Parbata under Police Station-Mirpur, District-Dhaka was requisitioned in LA Case No. 50/64-65. It is also not disputed that the aforesaid 0.66 acre of the aforesaid three plots was de-requisitioned on 8-6-1994 and on prayer of respondent awardee, the Government decided to hand over possession of the de-requisitioned land (0.66 acres of land) and issued a memorandum on 26-6-1994 to hand over possession of the said de-requisitioned 0.66 acre of land to the respondent. It is also not disputed that out of 0.66 acre of land possession of 15 decimals of land was handed over to the respondent out of above mentioned three plots on 7-2-2005 and a map was also prepared accordingly as it appears from a letter dated 5-2-2005 of the Officer of the Deputy Commissioner (Land Acquisition Department), Dhaka.
